title: The Evil in Me
description: An ongoing supernatural horror web series adapted from my original feature screenplay, reimagined as approximately one-minute episodes using traditional storytelling and AI-assisted production workflows. I manage the creative process from screenplay through final edit and release.

title: Head Games
description: An animatic-style concept trailer based on my original feature screenplay, combining cinematic editing, music, sound design, and AI-generated visuals to visualize the story, establish its tone, and demonstrate its cinematic potential.

title: Reaction to RFK
description: Political satire combining voice synthesis, AI-generated visuals, and comedic editing. This parody video generated more than 121,000 Facebook views, demonstrating strong audience engagement and shareability.

title: RFK Social Media PSA
description: Conceived, wrote, and edited a parody public service announcement using voice synthesis, AI-generated visuals, and short-form storytelling to deliver a humorous message about social media.

title: A Private Conversation – What Happened?
description: Conceptualized and edited a promotional teaser for A Private Conversation, using cinematic pacing, music, and editorial storytelling to build intrigue and encourage viewers to watch the podcast.

title: A Private Conversation – Failing
description: Developed the creative concept and edited a short-form promotional teaser using emotional storytelling and dramatic pacing to drive interest to the podcast.

title: The Test
description: Optioned feature screenplay • PAGE Awards Semi-Finalist.
